mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, status, create_user_id, check_user_id, check_time, remark
mapper.select:
select i.*, p.id 'project.id', p.name 'project.name', p.serial_number 'project.serial_number', p.short_name 'project.short_name', p.project_type, m.id 'monomer.id', m.name 'monomer.name', plan.id 'enclosurePlan.id', plan.name 'enclosurePlan.name' from business_check_info i inner join contract_project p on p.id = i.project_id left join plan_monomer m on m.id = i.monomer_id left join enclosure_plan plan on plan.id = i.enclosure_plan_id where i.bool_delete_enum = 0
and i.project_id = #{projectId}
-- 查询结构类型
and i.type = #{type} and (i.project_type & 3) > 0
and i.type = #{type} and (i.project_type & 3) > 0
and i.type = #{type} and (i.project_type & 8) > 0
and i.type = #{type} and (i.project_type & 64) > 0
and i.status = #{status}
AND date_format(i.check_time, '%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{dateTimeList[0]}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(i.check_time, '%Y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{dateTimeList[1]}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and i.bool_delete_enum = 0 order by i.status, i.create_time desc
select ifnull(count(*), 0) from business_check_info where status = 1 and bool_delete_enum = 0

SELECT CONCAT(cp.serial_number, ' ', cp.short_name) AS project, pm.name AS monomer,
'散发制品' as type_name,
'结构制品' as type_name,
'围护' as type_name, ep.name AS enclosurePlanName, case b.category WHEN 2 THEN '压型板' WHEN 4 THEN '夹芯板' WHEN 8 THEN '桁架楼承板' WHEN 16 THEN '压型楼承板' WHEN 32 THEN '折边件' end as category_name,
'配套制品' as type_name, b.quantity AS total_quantity, ROUND(ifnull(b.quantity, 0) * ifnull(bcd.new_unit_price, 0), 3) as total_amount, CASE b.use_property WHEN 1 THEN '工地' WHEN 2 THEN '工厂' END AS use_property_name,
bci.remark, bci.create_user_name, bci.create_time, bci.check_user_name, bci.check_time, CASE bci.status WHEN 1 THEN '未审核' WHEN 2 THEN '通过' WHEN 4 THEN '驳回' END AS status, (ifnull(b.total_weight, 0) / 1000) as total_weight, b.*, case bcd.new_pricing_manner when 0 then '重量' when 1 then '长度' when 2 then '面积' end as pricing_manner_name,
case bcd.new_pricing_manner
when 0 then ROUND((ifnull(b.total_weight, 0) / 1000) * ifnull(bcd.new_unit_price, 0), 3)
when 1 then ROUND(ifnull(b.total_length, 0) * ifnull(bcd.new_unit_price, 0), 3)
when 2 then ROUND(ifnull(b.total_area, 0) * ifnull(bcd.new_unit_price, 0), 3)
end as total_amount,
CONCAT(ifnull(bcd.old_unit_price, '未填写'), ' ▶ ', bcd.new_unit_price) as price FROM business_check_detail bcd LEFT JOIN business_check_info bci ON bci.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND bci.id = bcd.check_info_id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND cp.id = bci.project_id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pm.id = bci.monomer_id
inner join business_machine_part b on b.id = bcd.business_id
inner join business_artifact b on b.id = bcd.business_id
inner join business_enclosure b on b.id = bcd.business_id LEFT JOIN enclosure_plan ep ON ep.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ep.id = bci.enclosure_plan_id
inner join business_standard_part b on b.id = bcd.business_id
WHERE bcd.bool_delete_enum = FALSE
and bci.project_id = #{projectId}
and bci.type = #{type} and bci.project_type in (1,2,8)
